role: Guardian-facing write path: human statements, schema proposal review, and type approval workflow.
detail: Implements four public operations: add_guardian_statement (creates GuardianStatement instance node with GUARDIAN provenance at confidence 1.0 and GUARDIAN_STATEMENT edge to target); create_schema_proposal (creates SchemaProposal schema-level node at PENDING status with INFERENCE provenance, supersedes existing PENDING proposals for same type, creates EVIDENCE edges from evidence instances); apply_schema_proposal (approves proposal: sets status to ACTIVE, creates SchemaType schema node with GUARDIAN_APPROVED_INFERENCE provenance, creates INSTANCE_OF edges from evidence instances to new type); reject_schema_proposal (sets status to REJECTED, stores rejection reason as property to prevent re-proposal). Three result dataclasses: GuardianStatementResult, SchemaProposalResult (tracks superseded_proposal_id), SchemaTypeResult (returns type_node_id and instance_of_edge_ids). All operations are async, interact with GraphPersistence protocol, use uuid-based node/edge ID generation with readable prefixes.
gotchas: apply_schema_proposal and reject_schema_proposal both import NodeNotFoundError locally inside function body rather than at module top; _get_evidence_instance_ids depends on GraphPersistence.query_edges protocol (T303) which may not be available on older implementations; all operations assume persistence backend supports async save_node, save_edge, get_node, query_edges; no explicit locking/transactions around multi-step operations like create_schema_proposal (supersede + create new proposal) or apply_schema_proposal (activate proposal + create type + create edges)
